newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not established - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers not established on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1275 lbs 115.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 115.00, few 116.00.(weighted average 115.25)
Trade slow to nonexistent on Thursday. Prices on slaughter steers and heifers not fully established. Buyer inquiry and interest very limited, seller interest light.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - No confirmed sales. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1175 lbs 72.00.

For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis 1.00-1.50 higher, Dressed basis sales fully 2.00 higher. Weekly total includes 4,500 formulated and or previously contracted cattle. Confirmed - 1,400 Last Week - 39,900 Last Year - 5,300
Wk To Date - 58,400 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 54,600 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 36,900
